snippet.title: Curvature - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The Curvature Demo is coming to Steam Next Fest beginning June 9!

Curvature is a thrilling soulslike that blends beloved mechanics with fresh twists and unique abilities, set in a brand new, mysterious and atmospheric science fiction universe.

Nameless machine, on a mission in a highly volatile world. A planet controlled by gruesome creatures, abusing and corrupting everything in their reach.

Wishlist and play the demo on: https://s.team/a/2068850

Join the official https://discord.gg/CUZ7tGrYdn

Trailer and game by Pawel Lossew

Powered by #GodotEngine
